text:
customer-corp-ops: Hey @support — saw a big jump on our latest invoice. Our client SDK (js v1.4.2) estimates ~12k tokens for a batch of 250 calls on 2025-09-22 but invoice shows ~18k. Attaching minimal repro below, can someone confirm what's being counted?

lisa-support: Thanks — can you paste the exact request body / curl and one example response?

customer-corp-ops: Sure, minimal repro we used (streaming disabled here):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this log: ..."}]}'
```
Server returned usage block in JSON: 
```json
{"id":"resp_xxx","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"prompt_tokens":1460,"completion_tokens":220,"total_tokens":1680}}
```
Our local SDK estimator (same payload) reports prompt ~1100, completion ~220, total ~1320. So invoice matches server total, but SDK is lower on prompt.

lisa-support: OK. Do you commonly use any Auto-moderation or tools in your account? Any system messages you inject client-side?

customer-corp-ops: No deliberate system messages. We do use function-calls sometimes but not in this batch. Ran a curl capture from our side — payload we sent had only the user message above.

kevin-eng: pinging infra/telemetry. @maria-billing fyi. First pass: we sometimes prepend a short server-side system preamble for hosted tenants (policy/region tags, usage routing hints). That preamble is inserted by the routing plugin after the client computes an estimate, so client estimators can miss it.

maria-billing: That would explain higher prompt_tokens on the server. Do we have a log sample showing the injected preamble and token delta?

kevin-eng: yes — pulled the router trace for that request id. Snippet: 
```text
router_trace: incoming_messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this log..."}]
router_trace: server_preamble=[{"role":"system","content":"<region:us-east> apply-telemetry-v2"}]
router_trace: final_messages= server_preamble + incoming_messages
estimated_preamble_tokens=350
```
So server added ~350 prompt tokens. That matches invoice-server delta (1680 - 1320 ~= 360).

customer-corp-ops: Wow — is that supposed to be billable? We didn't opt into extra content being added.

maria-billing: We bill on the effective input the model received. Server-side insertions do count because they are part of the request seen by the model. That said, we try to be transparent. I can propose an invoice adjustment for this batch while we sort UX.

lisa-support: For short-term: we can issue a pro-rated credit for the unexpected ~350 tokens per request (or do a one-off invoice correction). @customer-corp-ops — would you like a credit or a manual edit to the invoice?

customer-corp-ops: A credit would be great. Also please tell us how to make our SDK estimator reflect this going forward so we can alert SRE/owners earlier.

kevin-eng: Action items: 1) Engineering will add an opaque header in the API response showing server-inserted-token-count for transparency. Proposed header: `x-rw-added-prompt-tokens: 350` 2) SDK team will update estimators to optionally include a `server_additions` heuristic when the header is present (next SDK patch). 3) We'll audit routing plugins that prepend content and document which tenants get them.

lisa-support: Timeline: billing team can process a one-time credit within 2 business days once you confirm the affected invoice. Eng will try to ship the header change within 5 business days (hotfix) and SDK estimator update in the next minor release.

maria-billing: @customer-corp-ops if you reply with the invoice id or the date range, I'll queue the credit and include a short note pointing to this thread.

customer-corp-ops: Invoice INV-2025-09-22-04. Thanks — we'd prefer the credit. Also FYI we rely on SDK estimates for alerting on anomaly thresholds, so the header + SDK change will be helpful.

billing-bot: Credit queued: INV-2025-09-22-04 -> credit 6,500 tokens equivalent. Ticket #BILL-5021 created.

kevin-eng: Follow-up: we found one router plugin `prepend-system-preamble` that runs for hosted customers in some regions for telemetry & content routing. We're going to:
- add `x-rw-added-prompt-tokens` header (hotfix)
- emit a debug log line with `router.trace` id when additions occur
- add documentation to "Billing & token counting" in the Console docs explaining server-side injections

lisa-support: I'll update the billing FAQ with a short blurb: "Server-side additions (preambles, telemetry markers) may be added for routing/moderation and are billed as input tokens; see header `x-rw-added-prompt-tokens` to reconcile."

customer-corp-ops: Appreciate the quick triage. One last ask — can we get a list of requests in our account that had server additions for last 30 days to validate our alerts?

kevin-eng: Yes — eng will provide an export (request id, timestamp, added_tokens) within 3 business days. We'll redact PII.

maria-billing: Credit processed. You should see invoice adjustment within 48 hours, and I'll follow up in this thread when it's posted. :white_check_mark:

customer-corp-ops: Got the credit notice. Thanks everyone. We'll wait on the header and SDK patch and will re-run our anomaly alerts after that.

lisa-support: Closing loop — marking this resolved for now. Reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
